summary: More commands ask before a change, and need --yes without a terminal. axiom secrets activate, revoke, rewrap, destroy, revoke-grant, disable-workload, update-environment, and bind when it updates an existing binding (a non-zero expected_revision) now ask; in 0.151.0 they ran without asking. The new axiom secrets rotate, axiom project resources revoke, axiom auth disable and axiom auth mfa set (when it changes the policy, factors or step-up window) ask too, as do the new axiom auth removals and deletions: providers remove, users delete and remove-factor, trusted-issuers remove, roles delete, permissions delete, assignments remove, organizations remove-member, suspending an organization or member, invitations revoke, email unsuppress, smtp remove and templates reset. For all of these, and for the axiom auth commands that already asked (users reset-factors, revoke-consent and revoke, webhooks delete, hooks remove, sms remove), a confirmation that cannot be asked is now refused before sign-in, any project lookup or any request, with exit status 2 and 'pass --yes to confirm without a prompt'; in 0.151.0 the axiom auth commands refused only after signing in, so a signed-out run exited 3. axiom auth oauth-apps delete still needs --confirm "delete client ID", now checked before sign-in. Among the other new command groups, axiom project environments reset and delete, axiom workspace members remove and invitations cancel, and axiom data sql write, tables write, saved-queries delete, capture create and capture settings set need --yes without a terminal and refuse with exit status 1 after reading the target; axiom intel changes (alert policies, observability settings and sources, pull requests, project settings) always need --yes, also on a terminal.
migration: In CI and other scripts without a terminal, review each listed command and pass --yes (or the typed --confirm phrase) where the change is intended. For axiom auth, axiom secrets and axiom project resources revoke, treat exit status 2 as a refused confirmation or usage error: nothing was sent to Axiom Cloud.
